technique_name: Compare and contrast feudalism and capitalism
description: Feudalism and capitalism are two of the most distinct economic systems in history. Feudalism was based on a hereditary noble class that held all the land and power, while capitalism was based on free trade and the free market. In feudalism, success was determined by the family’s class; in capitalism, success is determined by individual effort.
